sources.note: Main Uprise product site; redirects to helixsolution.com now. Previously had product info and feature pages.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms no additional costs for certified product (Uprise 3.1). Mentions NewCrop integration for e-prescribing, 11 CMS quality measures.
Vision(X) PMS & EHR page — next-gen replacement for Uprise under HELIX. Still in development as of page content. Confirms integrated scheduling, PM, EHR, billing, patient recall, ordering.
VisionWeb ordering platform page within HELIX portfolio. Shows 20,000+ practices, 475+ labs, 25+ PM integrations. Describes HELIX ecosystem of products.

Review of Optometric Business article on HELIX launch by EssilorLuxottica in Oct 2023. Confirms VisionWeb, CLX, 4PatientCare, RCM consolidated under HELIX. Vision(X) announced for Q2 2024. Uprise continues with full support.
Third-party EHR review site. Details features, pricing (~$104/mo), and user reviews (4/5, 7 reviews). Describes modules: EHR, PM, billing, patient portal, lab integration, reporting.

VisionWeb FAQ page. Lists Uprise modules: patient portal, scheduler, demographics, EHR, optical portal, checkout, billing code verification, insurance claims, ordering, recall, ePrescribing, messaging.
Blog post comparing Uprise Essentials vs Pro tiers. Essentials: PM + EHR + ePrescribing + secure messaging. Pro adds frame catalogs, patient recall, patient education, code verification.
Blog post on optical dispensing features: optical dashboard, frame catalog (Frames Data integration with daily updates), inventory tracking, order management, lab ordering, dispensing workflow.
Blog post on clinical features: CDS auto-populating diagnoses/treatment plans, drug interaction flags, ePrescribing via NewCrop/Surescripts to 60K+ pharmacies, change tracking/audit trails.

RCM service page. Describes managed billing service as 'extension of your billing team' — claims filing, rejection correction, denial appeals, performance reporting. Appears to be separate add-on service, not built into Uprise.
Blog on 4PatientCare integration with Uprise for automated patient recall and appointment reminders. Embedded in Uprise Pro at no additional cost. Uses Intelligent Escalation across text and email.
Review of Optometric Business article on Uprise launch. Cloud-based PM and EHR for optometry practices.
